supersedes: The previous contact-first priority list; no outreach is a prerequisite for scientific selection.

policy.decision_unit: Exact product in a defined disease and treatment window, paired with a decision-changing functional experiment.
policy.ranking: Rank the expected value of the next proof. Do not inherit priority from recency, number of mentions, an A label, a patent listing or supplier availability.
evidence_rules: Keep exact chemical/sequence identity, formulation, route, genotype, model maturity and timing attached to every claim.
Count independent biological donors/animals/couples. Technical wells, images, sections and time points are nested observations.
Deduplicate abstracts, articles, patents and follow-up analyses reporting the same underlying dataset.
Require direct useful function after disease establishment; distinguish prevention, markers and surrogate mechanics.
Use the strongest practical active comparator and measure exposure; failure against vehicle is not the only possible failure.
Test combinations factorially and require added value over the best single component.
Update related candidates when a relevant current clinical or functional negative result appears; retain model/indication distinctions.
Have an independent reviewer seek a decisive disconfirming explanation before top-priority promotion.
A changed analog, stereoisomer, sequence or salt inherits a hypothesis, not the prior article efficacy claim.
Preservation and prevention can be valuable but do not count as demonstrated delayed reversal.
A positive functional result is scored against the strongest current public comparator; later primary negatives remain attached to the record.
An inaccessible full method remains explicitly unverified; secondary commentary cannot fill a primary donor count or dose.
Classify source purpose before inferring availability: recruitment wishlist, planned grant, service, catalog and received lot are distinct.
Use primary corrections and dated investigator/sponsor updates alongside registry labels; completed does not mean successful.
A late-start response at an assay ceiling is not equivalence, full force restoration or durable reversal.
Record conflicts in source regimens, units and cohort linkage rather than silently selecting the favorable interpretation.
policy.no_contact_gate: Unknown commercial terms do not block public scientific selection. Identify known claims, testable routes and remaining uncertainty without substituting an owner reply for a scientific decision.
S_tier_criteria: large meaningful rescue in a relevant established-disease system
credible differentiation from the current comparator
no unresolved fatal safety signal at the required exposure
a compelling next development milestone with plausible value capture
policy.S_tier_result: No S-tier promotion. BLU3797, exact8015-P2, NDC-9009 and AAT retain staged proof status. RM4404 becomes a new independent-validation priority. APR-246/AEC is a serious local translational challenger; the public record does not establish NDC overall superiority.
policy.S_tier_note: S is a decision standard, not a quota, probability estimate, prediction of investor interest, or guarantee of clinical success.
policy.fundability_definition: A clear development milestone, reproducible article, relevant functional benefit, realistic exposure, differentiated value and plausible value capture. A numerical score cannot compensate for a missing decisive gate.

coverage_summary.count_note: Coverage records are not independent drugs. Historical topics, candidate concepts, repeated observations, platform ideas, methodology rows and formulation comparators overlap.

final_shortlist.name: Selective PIK3C2B inhibition for MTM1 myotubular myopathy
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Article-defined S stereoisomer BLU3797; key final synthesis disclosed from an advanced intermediate; complete end-to-end route not independently verified.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Independent genetic kinase inactivation rescues mouse force; BLU3797 improves survival and motor performance in severe Mtm1-null mice, including a late-start experiment. Source-workbook audit shows a60-second assay ceiling, an unresolved P22 survival-regimen header/caption mismatch, incomplete baseline measurements and absent cross-panel animal IDs. These limit exact late-start regimen transfer and equivalence claims.
final_shortlist.research_material_route: Plausible joined public route: two patent disclosures describe the exact upstream S-configured intermediate; journal methods supply final transformations. Mass/mole inconsistencies and translated details need reconciliation. Quote-based supplier route is not stock. No end-to-end reproduction or lot authentication.
final_shortlist.model_route: Curi p.L463S line plus separately cataloged Coriell GM06813 frameshift and GM24509 p.D394H fibroblast starting materials. Reprogramming/myogenesis disclosed in patent; neither new line is a ready qualified force model.
final_shortlist.exposure_risk: Require measured free exposure, mature-muscle rescue, neuronal network window and liver/mitochondrial tolerability; human genetic PIK3C2B loss can increase seizure susceptibility. The tamoxifen XLMTM hepatic safety halt is disease-context evidence, not proof of BLU toxicity. It strengthens the requirement for disease-specific bile-handling qualification.
final_shortlist.public_rights_note: Blueprint-origin published chemistry and existing target patent disclosures; neither pipeline absence nor an abandoned related application establishes commercial clearance.
final_shortlist.next_decision_question: Can measured PIK3C2B engagement reverse established human MTM1 force/fatigue deficits with separation from neuronal and hepatic dysfunction?
final_shortlist.proposed_advance_condition: Reproducible force and fatigue benefit after a stable disease deficit, across independent genotypes/backgrounds, with concordant target engagement and an interpretable safety window.
final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Only differentiation/morphology improves, effects occur only in one clone, no human force rescue at achievable exposure, or required exposure overlaps neural/liver injury.
final_shortlist.decision: first bounded human-function proof, after material/model qualification
final_shortlist.round3_delta: More concrete model route; narrower chemistry and assay-transfer claims. No new human BLU force efficacy demonstrated.
final_shortlist.round4_delta: Two public patent disclosures describe the matching S upstream intermediate, creating a plausible joined reconstruction route. Newly inspected source workbook verifies strong dose-dependent, ceiling-limited wire-hang observations but exposes an unresolved P22 schedule mismatch in the small late-start comparison, incomplete baseline records, and unlinked panel denominators.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Authenticate article and qualify a mature MTM1-dependent human force deficit. Then test delayed force/fatigue recovery at measured exposure, with genetic rescue and orthogonal target engagement. Evaluate neuronal function and MTM1-deficient canalicular transport at matched exposures; the latter is a model-development task.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Staged work queue, not a validated cross-program probability or investment-return ranking.

final_shortlist.name: 8015-P2 mitofusin activation for MFN2-CMT2A

alias_search_basis.scope: 622 coverage_records and 30 generated_concepts.proposals in research/portfolio-register.json; supplementary rg across ddiscov_snapshot and round2 files
alias_search_basis.caveat: New to reviewed inventory is not a claim of new invention, patent novelty, biological novelty, or unowned asset.

final_shortlist.exact_entity: The slower-eluting chiral SFC peak 8015-P2 defined in Weigele et al. 2024, with the article/supplement stereochemical and analytical reference; do not substitute parent 8015 mixture, MiM111, Chimera C, or generic piperine.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Exact P2 improves established sensory/motor phenotypes in approximately 50-week-old Mfn2 T105M knock-in mice and rats. The 2026 rat study randomized and blinded testing; dose cohorts contain four rats per dose and seven WT comparators. The 10 mg/kg cohort stopped at four weeks after normal-range values. A separate acute motility assay used 100 mg/kg, not the chronic dose.

biological_sample_counts.2026_rat_dose_response: 4 animals/dose; WT reference 7; counts of other cohorts differ and were not imputed
biological_sample_counts.2024_mouse_exact_P2: Histology 4 mice/group and synapse counts 3/group; functional panel n values reside in the figures and were not independently transcribed
biological_sample_counts.2024_human_8015_mixture: One T105M patient background; independent culture experiments are not donors
biological_sample_counts.2020_human_Chimera_C: Four patient backgrounds; chemically different article
biological_sample_counts.2020_MiM111_mouse: 6 mice/group; sample target reduced from planned 15 because effect was larger than anticipated

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.
final_shortlist.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a stable deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No P2 functional benefit in genetically rescuable models; parent mixture alone works; apparent benefit comes from hyperexcitability or generalized tissue growth; required exposure impairs healthy tissue or mitochondrial quality control.

independent_challenge.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
independent_challenge.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

final_shortlist.model_route: NYSCF/CMTA catalog identifies AG0002-01-MR(MFN2 H361Y),AG0008-01-MR(c.2219G>C; protein annotation needs reconciliation),and AG0015-01-MR(R364W),with iPSC and fibroblast routes. Distribution is request-based; dates are not a stock check. No exact T105M patient stock verified. Each line requires independent neuronal/neuromuscular qualification and isogenic control; engineered T105M is a separate rebuild branch. March2026 CMTA account adds an operating R364W service based on one patient and a healthy comparator. Function means transport/morphology there, not useful nerve-muscle transmission. Do not infer T105M stock from the Summer2024 recruitment table or ready organoid function from a future grant.
final_shortlist.round4_delta: CMTA describes an already-used BrainXell/ANANDA R364W motor-neuron screening assay. This improves a first mechanistic assay route but supplies no exact-P2 response or NMJ-force endpoint. Summer2024 T105M table was a donor wishlist, not inventory. R364W human-harm extrapolation in an older paper was withdrawn by correction.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Staged work queue, not a validated cross-program probability or investment-return ranking.

final_shortlist.name: NDC-9009 topical proof for ATP2A2 Darier disease

searched: ddiscov_snapshot/atlas/*.md
research/portfolio-register.json (622 coverage records, six shortlist entries, 30 generated concepts)
alias_basis.matches: No alias match. This establishes novelty only to the reviewed inventory, not worldwide novelty.

final_shortlist.exactarticle: NDC-9009, inferred systematic name 4-(dimethylamino)-N-(2-methylquinolin-8-yl)benzamide from published synthesis, [M+H]+306. Distinct from CDN1163. Topical formulation is a proposal, not a published clinical product.
final_shortlist.function: 2026 patient keratinocyte dispase mechanical-adhesion rescue with 5 µM NDC-9009 during a 4-hour calcium switch. Four isolates represent three donors: DD1/DD2 same p.Asn39Asp donor; DD3/DD4 two p.Gln177Pro donors. Three experimental repeats are not three independent patient cohorts. Earlier desmoplakin localization normalizes by four hours even untreated; its one-hour rescue used CDN1163, not NDC-9009.
final_shortlist.decision: Provisional local qualification priority; compare directly with APR-246/AEC proof value and RM4404 replication. No overall evidentiary superiority to APR-246 established.
final_shortlist.decidingproof: Authenticate compound against public MS/NMR; test after a stable mechanical/barrier deficit in donor-stratified mature Darier epidermis, alongside vehicle, CDN1163 and mechanistically distinct calcium-restoring comparators. Pair durable adhesion/permeability with viable-epidermis unbound drug and matched healthy-tissue injury. Predeclare a meaningful rescue threshold after measuring baseline assay variance.
final_shortlist.go: Advance if a reproducible donor-level mechanical and barrier recovery persists beyond washout at skin-achievable unbound exposure, with a margin to healthy-skin injury and added value against the strongest comparator.
final_shortlist.stop: Stop or redesign if benefit is limited to calcium-switch junction assembly, only markers improve, topical exposure cannot reach active concentrations, or rescue tracks generalized proliferation/healthy-skin damage.
final_shortlist.material_route: Public synthesis and analytical characterization; no batch acquired/authenticated. Published neurobiology studies used Neurodon-sourced material. Public synthesis provides a research route independent of contacting that company.
final_shortlist.exposure_gap: 5 µM nominal cell-medium concentration is not free epidermal exposure. No matched skin PK or quantitative SERCA healthy-skin window recovered.
final_shortlist.rights: Neurodon quinoline/SERCA patent family exists; exact NDC-9009 claim mapping and use/formulation scope not determined. No freedom-to-operate assertion.
final_shortlist.key_uncertainty: Treatment timing and biological donor denominator materially reduce strength relative to the headline.
final_shortlist.exact_entity: NDC-9009, inferred systematic name 4-(dimethylamino)-N-(2-methylquinolin-8-yl)benzamide from published synthesis, [M+H]+306. Distinct from CDN1163. Topical formulation is a proposal, not a published clinical product.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: 2026 patient keratinocyte dispase mechanical-adhesion rescue with 5 µM NDC-9009 during a 4-hour calcium switch. Four isolates represent three donors: DD1/DD2 same p.Asn39Asp donor; DD3/DD4 two p.Gln177Pro donors. Three experimental repeats are not three independent patient cohorts. Earlier desmoplakin localization normalizes by four hours even untreated; its one-hour rescue used CDN1163, not NDC-9009.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Authenticate NDC-9009, quantify dissolved/free assay exposure and topical delivery into viable epidermis, then treat a stable mature-skin adhesion/barrier deficit. Compare vehicle, NAC, CDN1163 and a clinically relevant active treatment where the model can evaluate it. Analyze independent backgrounds, washout/stress durability and healthy-skin function. A preventive arm tests a separate prevention claim. Include dantrolene as a mechanistically distinct comparator where route and model permit; its completed oral trial does not disclose a favorable outcome in the retrieved record. APR-246/AEC has stronger chronic-human-lesion evidence and is a competing local proof, not a Darier comparator.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reproducible delayed functional rescue at measured achievable epidermal exposure with a useful advantage over a simpler comparator and an adequate healthy-skin window.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: Only junction assembly/prophylaxis improves, formulation or irritation explains the apparent effect, drug cannot be delivered to viable epidermis at active exposure, or simpler comparator performs as well without a meaningful product advantage.

independent_challenge.finding: Published PBS pH7.4 solubility is0.23 micromolar, versus5 micromolar nominal concentration in the Darier assay (about22-fold). This is a formulation/exposure uncertainty, not proof the assay is invalid or a ceiling on skin exposure.
independent_challenge.biological_failure_mode: Residual SERCA may be inactivated in an established lesion. Junction-assembly protection may not translate to delayed repair.
independent_challenge.comparator: NAC protects mechanical adhesion in the same primary disease model. CDN1163 is a separate same-target comparator; no superiority follows from next-generation wording.

final_shortlist.model_route: Public JCI170739 SERCA2-perturbed keratinocyte model can guide an independently qualified build. Original N/TERT-2G and mutant clones are not verified standard stock. Catalog Ker-CT or primary HEKa/HEKn are alternative parent routes,not validated replicas. ATCC Lei CapCRL-1098 is an archival Mission Collection fibroblast without a public ATP2A2 genotype,not ready patient epidermis. The published Addgene PX458 route has industry-access restrictions; an independently validated commercial RNP implementation is a separate alternative. Existing treated cultures represent three donors and two actuator-domain variants with approximately70% SERCA2 protein. Biopsy-only DD5–7 are not extra efficacy donors. Qualify residual functional target rather than assume every ATP2A2 variant responds.
round4_delta: Both culture variants lie in the SERCA2 actuator domain. Mean protein abundance is about 70% of control; it is not a measured 50%-protein-null model. Calcium imaging in the retrieved section used DD2.
DD5–7 were biopsy immunohistochemistry samples, not additional NDC-treated culture donors.
DD3–4 required Y27632 during maintenance; all DD cultures and CTL1–2 received it for consistency. It was removed 24–36 h before assays, so there is no demonstrated concurrent ROCK-inhibitor confound.

The 2023 healthy-neuron result involved spine-neck morphology at 0.1 µM, with at least 10 neurons / 70 spines from one culture batch. It is not observed skin toxicity; the 2025 intraperitoneal CNS study does not qualify topical exposure.
The Darier paper section titled Solubility assay measures protein detergent solubility, not dissolved NDC-9009.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Staged work queue, not a validated cross-program probability or investment-return ranking.

final_shortlist.name: Alpha-1-antitrypsin for donor-lung repair during perfusion
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Plasma-derived human AAT; Zemaira is a specified manufactured starting product
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Eight donor-paired human lung experiments show physiological improvement; earlier abstract likely reports the same dataset. Pig ex vivo and recipient-treatment studies support separate claims. Independent2018 mouse transplantation work used active recombinant AAT, a non-inhibitory loop mutant, albumin and PR3/NE-deficient recipients. This strengthens protease-specific causality in cold preservation and does not establish exact warm-human formulation equivalence.
final_shortlist.research_material_route: FDA-approved product route establishes manufacturing precedent, not permission to relabel or evidence of EVLP compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: Declined human donor lungs on paired circuits; actual institutional organ access is not secured in this desktop review.
final_shortlist.exposure_risk: Warm 12-hour recirculation requires activity/stability/adsorption assessment; protein and electrolyte matching can change the apparent benefit.
final_shortlist.public_rights_note: CSL AAT organ-perfusion patent application identified. New value must be a better qualified repair regimen/product, not rediscovery of AAT use.
final_shortlist.next_decision_question: Does qualified dual NE/PR3 activity add durable organ function beyond physically matched perfusate and a simpler NE-selective comparator after washout?
final_shortlist.proposed_advance_condition: AAT supplies persistent useful gas-transfer/compliance benefit at qualified activity and adds value beyond the simpler comparator.
final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Stop the differentiated AAT product thesis if physical matching or the simpler comparator explains the useful effect, or if activity is lost before the intended treatment window.
final_shortlist.decision: small formulation/potency gate before larger organ validation
round3_delta: Patent pilot compares 10 mg/mL AAT with saline; protein/oncotic matching is unestablished.
Current label defines approximately 50 mg/mL reconstitution, mannitol/phosphate excipients, functional elastase-neutralizing potency, and a three-hour postreconstitution use interval.

Calculated contribution from a 50 mg/mL stock at 10 mg/mL final: stock fraction 20%, mannitol approximately 24–34 mM, phosphate 3–4 mM. This is a proposed formulation calculation, not the 2026 paper's recipe.
Canadian trial record last updated July 2026 lists UHN randomized Zemaira lung-transplant prevention trial as not yet recruiting; ex vivo-only route not established by record.
round4_delta: Independent 2018 study compared active recombinant AAT with a non-inhibitory reactive-center mutant and albumin during cold preservation. PR3/NE-null recipients were also protected; this strengthens protease-specific causality.
The inspected cold-storage regimen used 1 mg/mL AAT, 18h storage and 4h recipient reperfusion. This is separate from the warm human EVLP experiment.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Qualify NE and PR3 inhibition in the actual warm perfusate, then compare AAT with physically matched protein/excipient control and an NE-selective comparator. Require postwashout function under recipient-like reperfusion.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Staged work queue, not a validated cross-program probability or investment-return ranking.

generated_concepts.purpose: Consolidated generated-concept register; proposal counts are not counts of validated leads or patent-novel assets.
generated_concepts.assembly_method: Mapped from the three domain memos, neuro/metabolic generated-concepts JSON and root POLG handoff. No new literature research performed for this consolidation.

novelty_definition.new_to_repo: New exact lead or hypothesis relative to the reviewed inventory; may already be published, patented or in clinical development.
novelty_definition.refinement: An existing concept with a materially changed construct specification, route, timing, selection rule, comparator or decisive experiment.
novelty_definition.untested_combination: Defined parts combined in a proposed configuration whose incremental joint benefit is not established by the mapped evidence.

merged_proposals.reason: Both propose BPG10 plus full-length recombinant PRG4/lubricin to combine cartilage charge support and boundary lubrication.

original_dispositions.BL-N09: Reserve; require factorial bulk-load and friction benefit.

family_overlap.counting_rule: Two distinct design records in one family, not two independent platform discoveries.
family_overlap.design_distinction: NM-N05 uses vanillic acid plus CoQ10 in COQ9/selected COQ7 disease; NM-N06 tests 2,4-DHB add-on to CoQ10 in COQ8B nephropathy. The former combination has published mouse evidence; the latter proposed add-on still needs incremental function.

family_overlap.counting_rule: A single-agent workflow and an untested add-on design share AAT evidence; do not count them as independent efficacy confirmations.
family_overlap.design_distinction: BE-N01 prioritizes qualified AAT alone and washout durability; BE-N10 adds solnatide only after the single-agent proof.

cross_comparators.relationship: Topical insulin is both its own product/benchmark lane and the decisive active comparator for mIGF; distinct materials, not duplicate proposals.
Cognate tRNA and GCN2iB interrogate related GARS1 pathobiology but are different interventions; exact GCN2iB is downgraded.

proposals.name: Matrix-phenotype-selected PslG plus antibiotic
proposals.exact_component: Soluble PslG residues 31–442 plus tobramycin as the initial antibiotic benchmark; tag state and any protease-resistance variant must be explicitly fixed.

novelty_classification.basis: The domain screen found no PslG entry in the reviewed inventory; the new contribution is substrate-phenotype selection and a viable-clearance product test.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Primary enzyme studies and a 2026 comparison of 14 clinical isolates support substrate-dependent biofilm disruption and antibiotic-associated effects.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Biomass reduction is not sterilization; prior pulmonary coadministration does not prove treatment of established infection, and dissemination is a material boundary.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In established clinical-isolate biofilms, compare PslG, antibiotic, combination and inactive enzyme; quantify viable residual and dispersed organisms after physiological protease exposure and washout.

disposition.reason: Advance only if matrix selection predicts materially greater killing without increased viable dissemination.

proposals.name: Native DNase1L2 for actin-rich airway mucus
proposals.exact_component: Recombinant native human DNase1L2; do not substitute a PEGylated preparation without separately specifying it.

novelty_classification.basis: An exact native nuclease replaces the nonspecific idea of a better DNase.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Recombinant protein reduced viscosity in actin-enriched artificial cystic-fibrosis mucus; production and PEGylation were reported.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Native patient sputum transport and superiority to dornase or an actin-resistant clinical benchmark are unestablished.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Across independent patient sputum donors, compare native DNase1L2 with dornase and an actin-resistant benchmark using mucus transport and rheology, not DNA digestion alone.

disposition.reason: Artificial mucus efficacy is insufficient for an inhaled product thesis.

proposals.name: Qualified topical insulin for neurotrophic epithelial defects
proposals.exact_component: Human insulin in a specifically selected and stability-validated ocular vehicle; the memo does not fix a final formulation.

novelty_classification.basis: New to the reviewed inventory, but already an established clinical research and formulation topic.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human treatment series, a registered active randomized comparison and vehicle-dependent stability studies support a practical comparator/product lane.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: A generic insulin eye-drop concept is not a differentiated asset; the ongoing trial is not completed comparative proof.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Compare a qualified formulation under tear-like washout in persistent epithelial repair models, measuring durable closure, barrier restoration and ocular handling stability.

disposition.reason: Highly obtainable and scientifically credible, but differentiation and existing formulation claims constrain discovery priority.

proposals.name: Retained topical losartan for established corneal fibrosis
proposals.exact_component: Losartan in a retained ocular formulation; final excipient/retention system remains unspecified.

novelty_classification.basis: New inventory entry for a formulation-dependent corneal indication, not a newly discovered molecule or unclaimed use.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Published corneal work and an eight-eye 2026 series provide a direct starting point.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The eight-eye series showed no significant group improvement in visual, topographic or densitometric outcomes.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Test established corneal scars against an appropriate active comparator at measured, tolerable stromal exposure; require durable transparency/mechanical improvement after washout.

disposition.reason: Retention must produce an incremental functional effect rather than repeat a weak broad efficacy claim.

proposals.name: Topical PDE4 inhibition for post-injury epithelial adhesion rescue
proposals.exact_component: Topical roflumilast, with apremilast as the mechanistic benchmark; these drugs are not interchangeable evidence.

novelty_classification.basis: Changes the route and post-injury product question relative to the repository oral-apremilast concept.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Apremilast pretreatment improved adhesion biology in injected healthy human skin; follow-up supports Epac1 involvement.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Topical roflumilast has not reproduced that result in established human autoimmune injury; prevention and injected exposure do not establish clinical topical efficacy.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: After pathogenic-IgG injury in human skin or oral mucosa, measure tissue exposure, mechanical cohesion and barrier recovery with topical roflumilast versus relevant active therapy.

disposition.reason: The intended route must attain useful exposure and reverse established cohesion loss.

proposals.name: Defined dual KLK5/KLK7 cyclic peptide for local Netherton treatment
proposals.exact_component: A disclosed SFTI-1 analogue or phage-selected dual KLK5/KLK7 cyclic peptide; the source memo does not select a single sequence.

novelty_classification.basis: New specific material route in the screen; selecting the exact sequence remains a discovery decision.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Primary peptide series disclose sequences and inhibitory potencies; LEKTI and clinical KLK programs are available comparators.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Enzyme inhibition has not yet established durable SPINK5-deficient human epidermal barrier rescue for the proposed product.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Select one sequence and compare barrier function, proteolysis and local exposure in SPINK5-deficient human epidermis against LEKTI/KLK benchmarks.

disposition.reason: Competition and incomplete article selection prevent near-term promotion.

proposals.name: GM-CSF variant escaping pathogenic aPAP autoantibodies
proposals.exact_component: Engineered human GM-CSF with retained receptor activation and reduced pathogenic-antibody binding; no exact variant is supplied.

novelty_classification.basis: New exploratory protein-engineering hypothesis, not an obtainable validated drug article.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A 2026 primary study mapped patient-derived autoantibody epitopes/affinities across 28 patients.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: No defined escape variant with preserved receptor activity or broad patient-antibody escape is established by that evidence.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: First generate a sequence-defined variant and test receptor-dependent macrophage function across independent patient antibody preparations, including affinity-diverse controls.

disposition.reason: The crucial component must still be discovered; an epitope map is not a therapeutic construct.

proposals.name: Genotype-defined topical readthrough for SERPINB7 Nagashima keratosis
proposals.exact_component: Topical gentamicin in patients with a susceptible SERPINB7 nonsense variant; formulation and genotype window must be prespecified.

novelty_classification.basis: New inventory-level indication and functional-selection question; gentamicin readthrough itself is published.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A five-patient bilateral randomized study and patient-cell readthrough provide direct human starting evidence.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Restoration of functional inhibitor versus antibiotic-mediated effects, durable benefit and commercial differentiation remain unresolved.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Use variant-defined patient epidermis to compare gentamicin with controls, linking full-length functional SERPINB7 restoration to barrier recovery rather than antibacterial effects.

disposition.reason: Modest human evidence warrants a bounded functional proof, not an S-tier claim.

proposals.name: BPG10 plus full-length recombinant PRG4 for cartilage mechanics
proposals.exact_component: BPG10: approximately 180-kDa chondroitin-sulfate brush on an approximately 10-kDa poly(acrylic acid) core, plus defined full-length recombinant PRG4/lubricin.

novelty_classification.basis: The two domain proposals name the same charge-support plus boundary-lubrication combination and are counted once.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: BPG10 has local micromechanical evidence in four normal and four OA human donors; PRG4 supplies a separately motivated boundary-lubrication comparator.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Neither source establishes combined human bulk load support or superiority of the combination; AFM indents are technical measurements within donors.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Paired human OA explants with both singles and combination under cyclic loading/washout, requiring incremental bulk fluid-load support and lower friction without impaired viability.

disposition.reason: Promote only if separate bulk and friction defects are corrected and combination outperforms the better single component.

proposals.name: Low-frequency mIGF-Gel tested against insulin under washout
proposals.exact_component: Biotin-capped D-phenylalanine–YIGSSSR peptide, assembled as the published mIGF gel; independently authenticate sequence, stereochemistry and assembly.

novelty_classification.basis: The molecular material already exists in the repository; this reframes the active comparator, washout and dosing-frequency specification.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Rat acute debridement and steroid-suppressed delayed-healing studies support retention and epithelial repair.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Human neurotrophic efficacy and a practical advantage over topical insulin are not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In paired corneal models with persistent repair limitation and repeated tear-like washout, compare exact mIGF, an appropriate physical gel control, insulin and free IGF1 on durable closure/barrier and optical quality.

disposition.reason: A meaningful reduction in dosing burden or superior durable repair against insulin would define a product; PBS superiority would not.

proposals.name: Controlled AAT additive for donor-lung repair during EVLP
proposals.exact_component: Plasma-derived alpha-1-antitrypsin/A1PI, with Zemaira as the manufactured reference; warm-circuit compatibility and active concentration require qualification.

novelty_classification.basis: AAT perfusion repair is a newly generated product thesis relative to the reviewed inventory, with a lower-dose/washout contribution beyond published use.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A paired declined-human-lung study involved eight independent donors; pig EVLP and separate recipient-systemic AAT experiments support organ physiology.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The apparent 2020/2026 reports should not be counted as independent datasets; ex-vivo-only post-washout transplant durability is unproven.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Use donor-paired lungs and protein/excipient-matched optimized perfusion to test lower-dose active AAT and persistence after washout, followed by ex-vivo-only survival transplantation.

disposition.reason: Strong human physiological foundation and concrete supply; a new project must add durability, dose control or reproducibility, with known rights weighted separately.

proposals.name: Plasminogen replenishment plus alteplase in kidney NMP
proposals.exact_component: Human plasminogen plus alteplase in normothermic kidney perfusion; qualify activity/excipients if using a clinical plasminogen product such as Ryplazim.

novelty_classification.basis: A newly generated substrate-complete kidney microvascular rescue thesis, distinct from existing kidney antioxidant/perfusion concepts.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human kidney experiments support relief of microvascular obstruction; the central paired efficacy cohort was three donor pairs within a larger organ program.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Thirty-nine organs are not thirty-nine independent paired efficacy observations; filtration and post-transplant benefit are not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Randomized contralateral kidneys comparing combination, component controls and optimized NMP, using filtered-tracer clearance and perfusion uniformity after washout.

disposition.reason: Clear substrate lesion and attainable components, but functional recovery must exceed histological plug clearance.

proposals.name: Brief MAM exposure at renal reperfusion
proposals.exact_component: Diacetoxymethyl malonate (MAM), distinguished from dimethyl malonate (DMM), as a timed reperfusion intervention.

novelty_classification.basis: New exact chemical/timing concept in the inventory.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human/pig succinate mechanism and mouse renal functional rescue support treatment at reperfusion.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Treated-human-kidney efficacy is absent; benefit is sensitive to timing and metabolically realistic perfusate conditions.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Treat human donor kidneys at reperfusion with MAM versus DMM and vehicle under clinically realistic perfusion; require filtration/energy recovery after washout.

disposition.reason: Mechanistic rationale is strong enough to test, but human treatment function and context sensitivity remain decisive.

proposals.name: Local DiNAC lysis of VWF/platelet-rich obstructive clot
proposals.exact_component: N,N′-diacetyl-L-cystine (DiNAC); it is chemically distinct from N-acetylcysteine.

novelty_classification.basis: New exact disulfide-directed clot-phenotype concept.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human-blood flow and patient-clot work support effects on white VWF/platelet-rich clot.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Red fibrinous clot resistance, achievable local exposure and bleeding/endothelial safety are unresolved; related NAC clinical harms cannot be ignored or equated directly.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: At measured physiological-plasma local exposure, test phenotype-defined patient clots under flow for restored passage, viable distal embolic burden and endothelial injury versus active lysis controls.

disposition.reason: Advance only with a defined susceptible clot phenotype and a useful local exposure/safety window.

proposals.name: Apotransferrin timed to post-transfusion iron release
proposals.exact_component: Human apotransferrin delivered over the transient non-transferrin-bound-iron window after transfusion.

novelty_classification.basis: A narrow transient-exposure thesis, distinct from chronic anemia treatment.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human serum/bacterial-growth relationships and mouse rescue support the short iron-burst hypothesis; human binding activity is reported.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Chronic anemia benefit was not established, and transient iron binding alone is not evidence of tissue protection.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In transfusion-relevant human material, compare timed apotransferrin with matched controls on NTBI neutralization plus a prespecified tissue or cellular functional injury endpoint.

disposition.reason: A short-window benefit may survive the negative chronic-anemia result, but needs direct functional demonstration.

proposals.name: Reversible calcium chelation plus taurine for cold platelet storage
proposals.exact_component: EGTA-mediated reversible calcium chelation during storage plus taurine, with verified restoration of calcium-dependent function before use.

novelty_classification.basis: Combines separately supported anti-activation/clearance and metabolic interventions; their joint benefit has not been demonstrated.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Taurine was studied in ten human donors; EGTA pretreatment has mouse functional support; current unmodified cold platelets have a major randomized clinical comparator.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Combination benefit, post-transfusion recovery and superiority over contemporary prolonged cold storage are unproven.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Donor-blocked factorial storage study comparing each component and combination against current cold-storage practice, followed by recovery and hemostatic-function testing after calcium restoration.

disposition.reason: A storage biomarker or repeated twenty-one-day clotting result is insufficient differentiation.

proposals.name: DNase plus plasminogen to unlock retained tPA in resistant thrombi
proposals.exact_component: DNase I plus human plasminogen in a thrombus already exposed to tPA; extra tPA is an active comparator, not an assumed required third new component.

novelty_classification.basis: Refines existing DNase/fibrinolysis concepts around a measured retained-tPA and substrate/NET bottleneck.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A 205-thrombus study supports the retained-tPA/substrate hypothesis.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Clinical DNase evidence is mixed; a small pilot failed its recanalization endpoint, and a retrieved larger-trial abstract did not supply final efficacy results.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In resistant patient thrombi with measured retained tPA, compare DNase, plasminogen combination and additional fibrinolytic under flow, using reperfusion and embolic fragments rather than clot weight alone.

disposition.reason: A useful mechanistic refinement, but ex-vivo lysis cannot substitute for clinical recanalization.

proposals.name: Selective A2B blockade during EVLP
proposals.exact_component: ATL802 as the exact A2B antagonist benchmark; a final manufacturable candidate/formulation remains to be specified.

novelty_classification.basis: New exact pharmacological EVLP comparison in the inventory.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Pig transplantation work reported improved compliance with ATL802 during EVLP.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Oxygenation and edema were not improved over EVLP controls; human efficacy and a release-qualified product are absent.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Independently repeat EVLP/transplant physiology with the exact benchmark, requiring a donor/graft functional gain beyond compliance alone and measuring exposure.

disposition.reason: Incomplete functional advantage and product specification keep this behind AAT.

proposals.name: AAT plus solnatide for donor-lung barrier and fluid clearance
proposals.exact_component: Plasma-derived AAT plus solnatide/TIP peptide in EVLP, with each component separately qualified.

novelty_classification.basis: Adds fluid-clearance support to the AAT repair thesis; it does not create independent confirmation of AAT efficacy.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Each component has human-lung preparation evidence addressing related physiological functions.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The combination has no demonstrated incremental benefit; solnatide clinical boundaries remain relevant.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Only after confirming AAT-alone performance, use a donor-paired factorial EVLP comparison on sustained gas exchange, compliance and fluid clearance after washout.

disposition.reason: Do not add product complexity without superiority to the better single component.

proposals.name: BLU3797 for MTM1-deficient muscle
proposals.exact_component: BLU3797, the published stereodefined PIK3C2B inhibitor, with exact synthesis and Probechem PC-26519 research listing.

novelty_classification.basis: Exact small-molecule counter-enzyme lead replaces earlier MTM1 protein-entry bottlenecks.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Short-term late-start survival/wire-hang rescue in Mtm1-null juvenile mice, selected MTM1-null mouse cells and independent genetic target support.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Mature human patient-muscle force, durable reversal in chronic disease, and a neural safety/exposure margin are missing.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Mature human muscle force at measured exposure plus neural safety separation

disposition.reason: Potentially high-value functional rescue; prioritize human specific force and exposure/selectivity rather than another marker assay.

proposals.name: Transient CPTX protein plus timed rehabilitation after incomplete SCI
proposals.exact_component: CPTX recombinant fusion protein: neurexin-binding cerebellin-1 segment, trimerization element and AMPA-binding neuronal-pentraxin-1 segment; patent SEQ ID NO. 2; timed local pulse plus rehabilitation is proposed.

novelty_classification.basis: Changes timing, injury setting and activity regimen of an existing synaptic-organizer concept.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Published recombinant protein improves mouse SCI function; delayed treatment was in hemisection and immediate treatment in contusion.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Delayed contusion protein efficacy with durable circuit safety is not established by the peer-reviewed study; cell therapy is a different product.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Delayed contusion coordinated motor/conduction benefit after clearance without pathological excitation

disposition.reason: The valuable new contribution is delayed, transient protein benefit under an active rehabilitation comparison.

proposals.name: Post-onset cognate tRNA add-back in YARS1/GARS1 neuropathy
proposals.exact_component: AAV9-U6-tRNATyr; GARS1 cognate tRNA is related separate product

novelty_classification.basis: Specifies the cognate cassette and post-onset question; YARS1 and GARS1 are related products, not independent confirmations of one article.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Neonatal AAV9-U6-tRNATyr prevented functional neuropathy in homozygous Yars1 E196K mice; cognate specificity had informative controls.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Adult/post-onset reversal and delivery in the intended human genotype are unproven; an existing venture program is visible.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Adult/post-onset function; neonatal prevention does not establish reversal

disposition.reason: Strong biology; differentiate through established-disease function and exact product rather than rediscovering the platform.

proposals.name: Exposure-matched piclidenoson in Lowe OCRL deficiency
proposals.exact_component: IB-MECA/piclidenoson; chemically defined A3AR agonist

novelty_classification.basis: New exact indication benchmark found in the screen, coupled to a stricter exposure test.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Human organoid pathway/uptake rescue supports the mechanism.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The nominal organoid concentration is about eighty-eight-fold above a cited human total Cmax comparator; relevant free kidney exposure is not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Receptor-mediated uptake at human-plausible unbound kidney exposure; nominal organoid concentration is ~88x human total Cmax comparator

disposition.reason: Do not promote unless useful receptor-mediated rescue survives human-plausible exposure constraints.

proposals.name: Vanillic acid plus defined CoQ10 formulation in COQ9/selected COQ7 deficiency
proposals.exact_component: Defined vanillic acid plus optimized existing CoQ10 comparator

novelty_classification.basis: Combination is new relative to registry questions but already tested in published mouse work; proposed human function/exposure design is a refinement.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Vanillic acid plus CoQ10 improved survival/motor outcomes in Coq9 R239X mice; COQ7 fibroblasts provide limited human support.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Human COQ9 neural rescue, broad allele applicability and feasible chronic exposure are not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Factorial human function, metabolic flux and feasible exposure; genotype restriction

disposition.reason: Chemically concrete and inexpensive to falsify; require incremental tissue function over optimized CoQ10.

proposals.name: 2,4-dihydroxybenzoate add-on in COQ8B nephropathy
proposals.exact_component: 2,4-DHB plus CoQ10; renal gene-specific comparison

novelty_classification.basis: A renal gene-specific CoQ10 add-on design; shares a precursor-bypass family with NM-N05 but uses a different compound and genotype.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: 2,4-DHB showed renal prevention in a podocyte-knockout mouse model and mitochondrial rescue in human knockout cells; CoQ10 has patient comparator evidence.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Incremental podocyte filtration-barrier benefit of the proposed add-on over optimized CoQ10 is unproven.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Incremental human podocyte barrier function over optimized CoQ10

disposition.reason: Do not count this as an independent platform win or generalize across COQ genotypes.

proposals.name: Defined phosphatidylcholine/phosphatidylethanolamine for CMT1A
proposals.exact_component: Composition-defined phosphatidylcholine/phosphatidylethanolamine-rich material modeled on the published approximately 55% PC / 20% PE soy-phospholipid preparation, not unspecified lecithin.

novelty_classification.basis: New inventory mechanism with pre-existing clinical research; the increment is composition, tissue exposure and conduction.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: A defined soy-phospholipid material, approximately fifty-five percent PC and twenty percent PE, improved myelin and neuropathic function in CMT1A rats.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Human nerve delivery, mature conduction benefit and a differentiated product versus the existing clinical research effort remain unproven.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Mature human conduction plus lipid incorporation; no plasma-only surrogate

disposition.reason: Generic lecithin is not a new asset; measured neural incorporation and function could define a useful product.

proposals.name: GCN2iB benchmark for GARS1 neuropathy
proposals.exact_component: GCN2iB with orthogonal GCN2 and ZAK controls

novelty_classification.basis: New pharmacological bypass found and downgraded during the same search.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: GCN2iB improved some onset-treated Gars-mutant mouse motor/conduction endpoints.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: CMAP rescue was not significant; ZAK inhibition and low-dose GCN2 activation undermine clean target attribution.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Distinguish on-target benefit from ZAK inhibition and harmful low-dose GCN2 activation

disposition.reason: Retain as a mechanistic benchmark; a successor must separate GCN2 from ZAK and avoid an adverse low-exposure range.

proposals.name: Immobilized haptoglobin cartridge for CSF hemoglobin removal
proposals.exact_component: Purified haptoglobin immobilized on defined matrix; pressure-controlled device is proposed

novelty_classification.basis: Affinity removal already has precedent; new contribution is a controlled cartridge specification and validated capacity.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: Patient-CSF/artery experiments support hemoglobin sequestration/removal and vascular-function restoration.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: An immobilized pressure-controlled device with safe flow, no leaching and adequate rebound capacity has not been validated.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Paired patient-CSF clearance, vascular response, capacity, leachables and rebound; 8–12 independent samples proposed

disposition.reason: A tractable bench/ex-vivo step exists, but safe intracranial circulation is a later product question.

proposals.name: Sildenafil in genotype-defined ATP6 Leigh syndrome
proposals.exact_component: Exact sildenafil exposure matched to neural model; genotype-defined prospective study

novelty_classification.basis: Improves exposure qualification and prospective endpoint design for a published repurposing lead.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: 2026 small/large-mammal experiments and six individually treated Leigh patients support further study.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: The human observations are uncontrolled; genotype-specific benefit and relevant free neural exposure are not established.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: Human neural function at plausible free exposure then controlled motor/crisis outcomes

disposition.reason: Test exposure-matched human function before a controlled prospective disease study; do not claim a new molecule.

proposals.name: Sulbactam rescue of aggregation-prone POLG
proposals.exact_component: Sulbactam as the repurposed small-molecule component; final chemical form, exposure and genotype-specific product definition require qualification.

novelty_classification.basis: Root identified this POLG-aggregation lead independently of the thirty domain proposals; no patent novelty is claimed.

evidence_scope.demonstrated: The October 2026 primary report supplies engineered-cell and mouse functional evidence, as reviewed by root.
evidence_scope.not_demonstrated: Engineered HEK/HCT systems are not patient models; the A449T mouse has a mild phenotype, and drug-dose/exposure details need clarification before translational inference.

proposals.decisive_next_proof: In patient-derived or isogenic human cells with endogenous, aggregation-prone POLG variants, demonstrate mtDNA maintenance and respiratory function at measured clinically plausible unbound sulbactam exposure, separating aggregation rescue from nonspecific stress effects.

disposition.reason: Do not outrank direct human organ or mature-muscle proofs until genotype-appropriate patient function and exposure are demonstrated.

The ordinal work queue is not a validated expected-return ranking. final_shortlist.name: Selective PIK3C2B inhibition for MTM1 myotubular myopathy
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Published stereodefined BLU3797; exact synthesis in B1
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Independent genetic kinase inactivation rescues mouse force; BLU3797 improves survival and motor performance in severe Mtm1-null mice, including a late-start experiment.
final_shortlist.research_material_route: Public synthesis and Probechem PC26519 listing; quote-based listing, no inventory or received-lot confirmation.
final_shortlist.model_route: Curi Bio CB-SKM-XLMTM is a publicly listed p.L463S patient-derived 3D muscle model. One donor and supplier phenotype claims; isogenic control and additional donors must be qualified.
final_shortlist.exposure_risk: Require measured free exposure, mature-muscle rescue, neuronal network window and liver/mitochondrial tolerability; human genetic PIK3C2B loss can increase seizure susceptibility.
final_shortlist.public_rights_note: Blueprint-origin published chemistry and existing target patent disclosures; neither pipeline absence nor an abandoned related application establishes commercial clearance.
final_shortlist.next_decision_question: Does authenticated inhibition restore established human muscle force at an exposure separated from neuronal and hepatic toxicity?
final_shortlist.proposed_advance_condition: Reproducible force and fatigue benefit after a stable disease deficit, across independent genotypes/backgrounds, with concordant target engagement and an interpretable safety window.
final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Only differentiation/morphology improves, effects occur only in one clone, no human force rescue at achievable exposure, or required exposure overlaps neural/liver injury.

final_shortlist.name: Alpha-1-antitrypsin for donor-lung repair during perfusion
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Plasma-derived human AAT; Zemaira is a specified manufactured starting product
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Eight donor-paired human lung experiments show physiological improvement; earlier abstract likely reports the same dataset. Pig ex vivo and recipient-treatment studies support separate claims.
final_shortlist.research_material_route: FDA-approved product route establishes manufacturing precedent, not permission to relabel or evidence of EVLP compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: Declined human donor lungs on paired circuits; actual institutional organ access is not secured in this desktop review.
final_shortlist.exposure_risk: Warm 12-hour recirculation requires activity/stability/adsorption assessment; protein and electrolyte matching can change the apparent benefit.
final_shortlist.public_rights_note: CSL AAT organ-perfusion patent application identified. New value must be a better qualified repair regimen/product, not rediscovery of AAT use.
final_shortlist.next_decision_question: Does a qualified ex vivo-only treatment produce meaningful sustained lung repair after washout and recipient reperfusion?
final_shortlist.proposed_advance_condition: Donor-level functional benefit over optimized matched perfusion, persisting after washout and in a transplant validation model.
final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Effect disappears with protein/oncotic matching or after washout; circuit physiology improves without durable graft benefit.

final_shortlist.name: Transient CPTX synaptic connector for incomplete spinal cord injury
final_shortlist.origin: recovered existing functional-comparison lead; refined proof design
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Exact disclosed CPTX protein sequence and oligomeric architecture
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Peer-reviewed motor/conduction benefit in mouse injury models; tiny additional delayed-contusion examples are in a patent. Cell-transplant follow-up uses a different product.
final_shortlist.research_material_route: Public sequence and production route support commissioned research material; no exact ready-stock protein source verified.
final_shortlist.model_route: Delayed incomplete-contusion model with balanced baseline severity and blinded function; research model is feasible but no operator/stock booked.
final_shortlist.exposure_risk: Local delivery and circuit distribution must be demonstrated for the chosen route; excessive excitation, pain and spasticity are functional risks.
final_shortlist.public_rights_note: Keio/Fujita patent family includes sequence, delayed injury and rehabilitation; the proposed proof adds qualification, not automatically a novel-use claim.
final_shortlist.next_decision_question: Can a transient defined protein treatment improve coordinated function after established contusion without pathological circuit activation?
final_shortlist.proposed_advance_condition: Independent improvement in coordinated movement and conduction after protein clearance, with acceptable pain/spasticity and reproducible lots.
final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Only staining/reflex scores improve; benefit disappears in delayed injury, requires a different product route, or produces harmful excitation.

final_shortlist.name: Defined mIGF peptide gel for persistent epithelial repair
final_shortlist.origin: recovered existing screen; comparator and product thesis refined
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Rat acute and dexamethasone-suppressed healing evidence supports retention/repair; not human chronic denervation efficacy.
final_shortlist.research_material_route: Public short-peptide identity supports independent synthesis and lot qualification; no finished clinical product verified.
final_shortlist.model_route: Paired donor corneal tissue under tear-like washout, then a relevant persistent-defect/denervation model.
final_shortlist.exposure_risk: Optical clarity, assembly consistency, delivered bioactivity and repeated-dose epithelial integrity must survive realistic use.
final_shortlist.public_rights_note: Nankai CN121949581A and CN113321706B identify existing claims; no assertion of new molecular invention.
final_shortlist.next_decision_question: Does the gel outperform validated topical insulin, or match useful repair with a meaningful dosing/handling advantage?
final_shortlist.proposed_advance_condition: Durable barrier repair and adhesion under washout with an active-comparator advantage and clear optical performance.
final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Only PBS is beaten, advantage is explained by unequal exposure, or haze/fragile epithelium offsets closure.

final_shortlist.name: FeM1269 for inflammatory iron restriction

final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Mouse anemia recovery and transport chemistry; mixed inflammatory/dietary/blood-loss model with waning hepcidin. Hinokitiol human evidence is class support, not exact-compound proof.

final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Iron efflux rises without erythroid function, required exposure is implausible, or labile iron/toxicity rises with benefit.

new_candidate_screens.material_route: Exact mouse sequence/peptide and synthesis methods are public. Human-targeted exon-skipping sequences are disclosed separately in WO2025085810A2, but selecting a human product and proving functional rescue are additional work.

new_candidate_screens.decision: Advance a bounded human-sequence/functional translation package; second strongest new lead. Do not call the mouse construct a ready human asset.
new_candidate_screens.ranking_delta: Adds a mechanistically distinct, publicly specified force-rescue route beside PIK3C2B. Does not inherit BLU efficacy or MTM1 applicability from a DNM2 R369W mouse.
new_candidate_screens.deciding_proof: Select and authenticate a publicly specified human DNM2 splice oligo; verify its exact splice product and absence of persistent harmful truncated protein. In mature DNM2-mutant human muscle, compare post-deficit force and fatigue with a sequence-matched non-targeting conjugate, unconjugated PMO and an orthogonal DNM2 reduction control at matched protein suppression. new_candidate_screens.advance_condition: Human sequence yields reproducible force rescue after disease establishment, with durable exposure-linked muscle suppression and a credible separation from off-muscle or conjugate toxicity.
new_candidate_screens.stop_condition: Only transcript/protein change; no useful force recovery; toxicity appears at the degree of suppression required; human targeting requires a materially different conjugate whose effects have not been qualified.

existing_candidate_updates.name: BLU3797/PIK3C2B: human-model and assay-transfer delta
existing_candidate_updates.functional_evidence: No new BLU3797 human force result or new independent drug efficacy study was found. Prior mouse and genetic reversal evidence remains; this update changes feasibility and measurement requirements, not efficacy score.

newly_resolved.finding: Coriell GM06813 catalog identifies an MTM1 exon8 frameshift (646delT with nearby648C>A); GM24509 identifies c.1180G>C, p.D394H. They are distinct mutation backgrounds. Patent WO2025085810A2 examples10–12 explicitly describe these fibroblasts being reprogrammed at iXCell, then differentiated into immature myotubes. The catalog cells are fibroblasts, not ready force tissues.

Addgene238834 publicly lists a NanoLuc-PIK3C2B vector. The BLU study used tailored fusion constructs and an in-house tracer. The public vector supplies one component; the exact published NanoBRET assay is not turnkey.

The main article discloses stereodefined identity and key final steps from advanced Intermediate3, with analytical data. End-to-end starting-material synthesis was not verified; narrow the old claim of a complete public route accordingly.

still_unresolved.finding: No human/mouse plasma fu, unbound muscle/brain partition coefficient or chronic exposure-linked EEG/liver margin was located. Total plasma with serum-adjusted cellular potency cannot supply those values.

Reported target-engagement potency for PIK3C2B is68.2nM; the enumerated live-cell panel omits PIK3C2A and class-I PIK3CB. Broad single-concentration kinome screening does not substitute for these cellular curves.

BLU2720 is weaker, not an assumed inactive control. PI-701 has limited selectivity characterization; PITCOIN compounds center on C2alpha and should not be mislabeled C2beta comparators. Genetic PIK3C2B perturbation is the cleaner publicly defined orthogonal route.

existing_candidate_updates.genetic_safety_delta: The primary epilepsy study explicitly notes reduced penetrance, including an unaffected transmitting father, and one variant retaining catalytic activity. This limits deterministic interpretation. Heterozygous loss-of-function and induced-seizure susceptibility still make neuronal target inhibition a specific hazard; constitutional genetics does not provide a drug concentration threshold.
existing_candidate_updates.exact_entity: BLU3797 article-defined S stereoisomer, authenticated independently; only then interpret either supplier lot or custom material.
existing_candidate_updates.model_route: Initial Curi p.L463S 3D line plus separately qualified GM06813 frameshift and GM24509 p.D394H derived models. Each requires identity, maturation, isogenic restoration/correction control, and pre-randomization stable force deficit. Distinct catalog genotypes are not three validated human responses.
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Retain first neuro/muscle bounded-proof priority. Raise operational confidence in a no-outreach model route, but do not raise biological maturity or call S-tier.
existing_candidate_updates.ranking_delta: More concrete and less dependent on unique investigator material; narrower claims about exact chemical route and assay transfer. No evidence-based reason to replace BLU as first proof solely because P2 is new.

new_evidence: A 2020 PLC-zeta-null sperm study directly compared recombinant human PLC-zeta, strontium, ionomycin and TPEN. It reported 326 MII oocytes across control and treatment conditions; that is not 326 independent donors. Recombinant PLC-zeta and ionomycin blastocyst rates were 41% and 50%, respectively, and a superiority benefit for recombinant PLC-zeta was not established. This is not proof of inferiority or equivalence.

September 2026 R385Q mechanistic work found retained recombinant catalytic activity and normal calcium oscillations after cRNA injection into mouse oocytes, supporting protein insufficiency rather than an obligatory catalytic defect in that variant. This is not a recombinant-protein treatment trial.

A 2024 39-couple retrospective ionophore study included 10 PLC-zeta-deficient patients with a fertilization improvement signal. Its historical comparison does not establish an unbiased treatment effect, but demonstrates that PLC-zeta deficiency alone does not identify an ionophore-refractory niche.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: The physiological-oscillation narrative does not establish product differentiation. existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Use a sequence-defined, lot-qualified reagent in a donor-clustered comparison against ionomycin. Continue only for a reproducible developmental or handling advantage; do not assume superiority from oscillation shape.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain conditional proof; strengthen formulation and comparator gates
new_evidence: The primary paper reports a corneal-sensitivity improvement and day-7 nerve measurements in the steroid-delayed model; Figure 8 labels n=3. This adds a functional signal beyond nerve staining but remains a small, single-paper result.

The paper reports a critical aggregation concentration of 205 micromolar, a 0.4 wt% formulation, and cell assays at 10-400 nanomolar with peak proliferation at 50 nanomolar. The active species and relevant free exposure therefore cannot be inferred from nominal gel concentration alone.
Single-motif, scrambled-peptide and blank-hydrogel controls exist in the delayed-healing experiment. It would be inaccurate to say the paper used no material controls.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: A practical reduced-frequency repair product remains plausible. The intended product should be the exact biotin-D-Phe peptide gel, with assembly, release, optical quality and functional potency qualified together. Small delayed-model groups and a missing insulin comparison prevent promotion to a development-ready winner.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: First test two independently prepared peptide lots for identity, assembly, release and clarity in tear-like medium. Then compare the exact formulation with validated topical insulin, free IGF-1 and a characterized vehicle in paired donor corneal tissue under washout. Advance on durable barrier/adhesion recovery with a meaningful dosing or functional advantage, and separately validate sensation in a relevant innervated persistent-defect model. Do not call an ex vivo cornea a sensation model.
existing_candidate_updates.remaining_retrieval_limit: Full supplementary methods, delayed-treatment biological-unit accounting, and all dosing/randomization/blinding details were not verified. Indexed primary text and Figure 8 legend were retrieved; this is not a claim of complete supplemental audit.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain focused human iron-transfer proof; strengthen active comparator
new_evidence: The 2022 hinokitiol study's human macrophages came from three ferroportin-disease patients with G80S, N174I or A77D variants. These findings support a donor-based ferroportin-defect model, not exact-FeM efficacy in those donors.

A separate 2023 primary study found iron-loaded deferiprone supported human cultured-red-cell hemoglobinization and oxygen-binding behavior while recycling transferrin. In that culture setting, hinokitiol was less effective than deferiprone/deferoxamine in supporting proliferation and transferrin reloading. That is a different task from extracting macrophage iron under hepcidin restriction.

A 2026 public neurodegeneration patent application explicitly depicts FeM-1269, providing additional public-rights context. It does not establish a human clinical program or clear rights for the proposed anemia use.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: The decisive advantage must lie in accessing sequestered iron and delivering it usefully, rather than merely supplying iron to erythroblasts. The available human-culture comparator makes a vague 'better iron carrier' claim too weak.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Separate macrophage extraction from erythroid delivery. Use isotope-tracked donor iron, persistent hepcidin restriction, holo-transferrin as a positive control, and a defined iron-loaded-deferiprone delivery benchmark. Match delivered iron where the question is erythroid uptake, and keep loaded and unloaded chelator conditions distinct. Require heme incorporation and maturation without harmful labile-iron redistribution. A result limited to the delivery arm is insufficient for the inflammatory-anemia thesis.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain independent-replication reserve; no automatic evidence upgrade
new_evidence: A targeted current search again recovered the 2020 injected-protein study and the 2024 CPTX-expressing-cell study, without a separately verified independent delayed-contusion replication of the exact injected protein. This is a bounded search result, not proof that no other study exists.
Primary methods specify local intraspinal injection. A later review describes intrathecal dosing; the review is not sufficient evidence for substituting a different delivery route.
The current company named CPTx develops DNA-based genetic medicines. A shared name is not evidence that it owns or develops the synaptic-organizer protein.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: A new synthesis of the public research protein plus an independent delayed-injury function/safety experiment remains concrete. Existing reviews and a separate cell product do not close that decision. Delivery and persistent excitation remain substantive product issues.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Use the published protein and local route as the reference. Before a larger behavioral study, establish tissue distribution and a window between useful evoked transmission and spontaneous/pathological activation. Then evaluate delayed incomplete contusion with baseline stratification, blinded coordinated function and matched rehabilitation. Treat intrathecal delivery, tag removal or a carrier as separate comparability changes.

cross_challenges.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
cross_challenges.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

cross_challenges.finding: Published PBS pH7.4 solubility is0.23 micromolar, versus5 micromolar nominal concentration in the Darier assay (about22-fold). This is a formulation/exposure uncertainty, not proof the assay is invalid or a ceiling on skin exposure.
cross_challenges.biological_failure_mode: Residual SERCA may be inactivated in an established lesion. Junction-assembly protection may not translate to delayed repair.
cross_challenges.comparator: NAC protects mechanical adhesion in the same primary disease model. CDN1163 is a separate same-target comparator; no superiority follows from next-generation wording.

cross_challenges.finding: Primary abstract supports preservation in declined human lungs during perfusion. Delayed rescue, exact human dose/n and recipient benefit are not verified.
cross_challenges.material_boundary: Free base CAS2271358-64-4 and HCl CAS2271358-65-5 are not interchangeable lot specifications; exact human-study formulation remains to be reconciled.
cross_challenges.competitive_boundary: University explicitly identifies FXT-001 as FiriX lead. Count as an active external program and conditional differentiated proof, not unclaimed material.

neuromuscular.review_scope: Focused primary-source delta review plus nine exact named candidate screens; not an exhaustive global search or a claim of FTO.
family_counting_rules: 8015-P2, parent8015, trans-MiM111 and ChimeraC appear in one mitofusin family record and are not independent discoveries or interchangeable evidence.
Published murine PPMO6 and separately patented human DNM2 oligos are one translation family; human design is not a second efficacy result.
CKD504 CMT1A and CMT2D data share one intervention record but retain disease/model distinctions.
Prior BLU refinement is not a new candidate.
